title: I Have Not Appreciated What You
summary: Gratitude is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord
lifeApplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord
source.lifeApplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Let the line meet the ordinary room before self-judgment starts arranging it.

evidence.coreClaim: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord
evidence.turn: Real gratitude does not inflate the self. It softens it.
